# taxi wien app — the taxi app for Vienna (full content)

> taxi wien app is the taxi app for Vienna. Order a licensed taxi anywhere in Vienna in seconds, follow your driver live and pay the official tariff – also to and from Vienna Airport (VIE). Book in the app or on WhatsApp.

This file holds the complete content of https://taxiwien.app in one place. A short overview is at https://taxiwien.app/llms.txt.

## Key facts
- Name: taxi wien app (written in lowercase)
- What it is: a taxi app for Vienna, Austria, for iOS and Android
- Where: the whole city of Vienna, Vienna International Airport (VIE) and trips to nearby towns and cities
- Prices: the official taxi tariff set by the City of Vienna; amounts on the website are estimates per vehicle
- Passengers pay no commission, booking fee or service charge to taxi wien app
- Payment: the fare is paid directly to the driver (cash, or card where the driver accepts it); taxi wien app does not process ride payments
- Drivers: independent, licensed taxi drivers using the taxi wien Driver app; each driver decides which requests to accept
- Booking: the taxi wien app, the booking form on https://taxiwien.app or WhatsApp (https://wa.me/491639542799)
- Support: support@taxiwien.app
- Operator: Berlin GmbH LLC (https://berlingmbh.com/)
- Languages: English (https://taxiwien.app/en), German (https://taxiwien.app/de), Turkish (https://taxiwien.app/tr)

## How to order a taxi in Vienna with taxi wien app
Your request. Your route. The driver decides. taxi wien app sends your ride details to licensed taxi drivers nearby – with no booking fee for passengers and no payment through the platform.
1. Log In with Mobile Number: Enter your mobile number and sign in, then start a new taxi request whenever you are ready.
2. Set your pickup point: Use the map or search to share where the ride should start – anywhere in Vienna.
3. Choose where you are going: Add your destination, for example Vienna Airport, so the route is clear before you send the request.
4. Check the Price & Send Request: Review the route and the estimated fare at the official tariff. When everything looks right, send your request to licensed drivers nearby.
5. Your Driver Is on the Way: When a driver accepts your request, you see their name, rating and trip details in the app and can follow the taxi live.
6. Rate Your Driver: Pay the driver directly at the end of the ride, then share your feedback in the app.

## Order a Taxi in Vienna in Seconds
Order a taxi anywhere in Vienna in seconds, follow your driver live on the map and see the estimated fare before you go. From your doorstep to the Hauptbahnhof, the Prater or Vienna Airport – taxi wien app is the easiest way to get a taxi in Vienna.

## Taxi in Vienna – Frequently Asked Questions
### Is there a taxi app for Vienna?
Yes. taxi wien app is a taxi app for Vienna. Download it for iOS or Android, enter your pickup point and destination, and a licensed driver nearby receives your request.

### How do I order a taxi in Vienna?
Open the taxi wien app, choose where you are and where you want to go, and confirm. You can also send your request on WhatsApp or use the booking form on this page.

### How much does a taxi cost in Vienna?
Fares follow the official taxi tariff set by the City of Vienna: a base fee plus a rate per kilometre and for waiting time. The app shows an estimated fare before you ride.

### Can I order a taxi to or from Vienna Airport?
Yes. taxi wien app takes you to and from Vienna International Airport (VIE). A ride between the airport and the city centre is estimated at about €34 per vehicle.

### How do I pay for my taxi?
You pay the driver directly at the end of the ride, in cash or by card where the driver accepts it.

### Do I pay a commission or booking fee?
No. Passengers pay taxi wien app no commission, booking fee or service charge. You pay only the fare, directly to the driver.

## Airport Taxi Wien – Vienna Airport Taxi
An airport taxi in Vienna takes you from Vienna International Airport (VIE) in Schwechat straight to your address – or from your door to the airport. With taxi wien app you order by app or WhatsApp, see the estimated fare at the official tariff first and pay the driver directly.

Vienna International Airport (VIE) lies in Schwechat, about 18 km south-east of the city centre. All terminals sit in one connected building, so arriving passengers reach the same arrivals area and taxi rank. Knowing your terminal and your options saves time after landing.

### Terminal 3
Terminal 3 is the newest part of the airport and serves Austrian Airlines and most Star Alliance partners, including many long-haul flights. The railway station for the CAT, S7 and ÖBB trains is reached from the arrivals level, and the taxi rank is just outside the arrivals exit.

### Terminal 1 & 1A
Terminal 1 handles most low-cost and charter airlines such as Ryanair, Wizz Air, Eurowings and easyJet; Terminal 1A is used as overflow. They are connected to Terminal 3 through the central arrivals plaza, so the walk to the taxi rank and the trains is short.

### Finding Your Taxi
Licensed Vienna taxis carry a yellow TAXI sign on the roof and wait at the official rank directly outside the arrivals exit. If you ordered with the taxi wien app or on WhatsApp, your driver meets you at the arrivals exit – open the app to see where your driver is.

### Vienna Airport FAQ
### How do I get from Vienna Airport to the city centre?
By car it takes about 16 minutes to reach the city centre (Stephansplatz), about 19 km. With the taxi wien app the estimated fare is about €34 per vehicle, calculated at the official tariff.

### How do I get from Vienna Airport to Bratislava?
Bratislava is about 60 km from Vienna Airport, roughly 50 minutes by car. A taxi wien app ride to Bratislava Airport (BTS) is estimated at about €76 per vehicle.

### Is there a train from Vienna Airport to the city?
Yes. The City Airport Train (CAT) runs non-stop to Wien Mitte in about 16 minutes, the S7 suburban train serves several city stations, and ÖBB Railjet trains go to Wien Hauptbahnhof. For door-to-door trips with luggage, a taxi is usually the most comfortable choice.

### Do I have to queue for a taxi at Vienna Airport?
At busy times there can be a queue at the taxi rank. A pre-booked taxi wien app ride lets you skip it – your driver is already waiting at the arrivals exit.

### Can I use Uber or Bolt at Vienna Airport?
Ride-hailing apps operate in Vienna, but their prices can rise with demand. taxi wien app charges the official tariff set by the authorities and works with licensed local drivers.

## How much is a taxi in Vienna?
How much is a taxi in Vienna? The official taxi tariff 2026, estimated fares from Vienna Airport to the city centre, to Graz and more – plus tips to avoid surprises.

### How are Vienna taxi fares calculated?
Vienna taxi fares follow the official city tariff: a base fee, a rate per kilometre that gets cheaper on longer distances and a charge for waiting time. A higher tariff applies at night, on Sundays and on public holidays. Trips to and from the airport and outside Vienna are often agreed as a flat price in advance.

### Vienna Taximeter Tariff 2026 (approximate)
- Base fee: about €3.80 by day, €4.30 at night
- Per kilometre: about €1.05–1.42 by day, depending on distance
- Night, Sunday and holiday tariff: about 15% higher
- Waiting time is charged per minute
- Surcharge for ordering by phone or app

Tariffs are set by the City of Vienna and can change. Always check the taximeter.

### Questions about taxi prices in Vienna
### How much is a taxi in Vienna?
At the official tariff a Vienna taxi costs a base fee of about €3.80 plus roughly €1.05–1.42 per kilometre by day. The taxi wien app shows the estimated fare for your route before you order.

### How much is a taxi from Vienna Airport to the city centre?
About €34 per vehicle (estimate at the official tariff) for the roughly 19 km ride, which takes about 16 minutes.

### How much is a taxi from Vienna to the airport?
From the city centre to Vienna Airport it is about €34 per vehicle; the ride takes about 25 minutes.

### How much is a taxi from Vienna to Graz?
For the roughly 182 km ride, expect about €266 per vehicle; taxi wien app shows the estimated fare before you order.

### Is a taxi or Uber cheaper in Vienna?
Since 2021 the same tariff applies to taxis and Uber in Vienna; pre-booked app rides may be priced up to 20% below or above it. With taxi wien app passengers pay no commission or service fee.

## Private Taxi Vienna: your own ride with a licensed taxi
People looking for a private taxi in Vienna usually want a ride of their own: just you and your party in the car, straight from the pickup address to the destination. That is exactly what every ride with taxi wien app is – with a licensed taxi driver, at the official tariff and with no commission for passengers.

### What does private taxi mean in Vienna?
A private taxi is a ride that is not shared: the car drives only for you, with no other passengers and no detours. You decide the pickup point, the destination and the time.
Every ride with taxi wien app is a private ride like this – in the city, to Vienna Airport or to another city.

### Private taxi and the law: why only licensed taxis
Since 1 January 2021 Austria has a single trade for carrying passengers by car for money: the taxi. The former private-hire trade was merged into it, and all providers – including ride-hailing apps – follow the same rules.
Anyone who carries passengers for money therefore needs a taxi licence and a taxi driver's permit. Only registered, official taxi operators receive your request through taxi wien app.

### How to order your private taxi
Ordering takes less than a minute:
- Open the taxi wien app or write to us on WhatsApp.
- Enter your pickup point and destination.
- See the estimated fare at the official tariff.
- Send the request – a licensed driver nearby accepts it.
- Pay the driver directly at the end of the ride.

### How much does a private taxi in Vienna cost?
The official Vienna taxi tariff applies: a base fee of about €3.80 and roughly €1.05–1.42 per kilometre by day. From Vienna Airport to the city centre the estimated fare is about €34 per vehicle – not per person.
Passengers pay taxi wien app no commission, booking fee or service charge. You pay the fare directly to the driver.

### Is a private taxi in Vienna more expensive than a normal taxi?
No. With taxi wien app every ride is private and costs the official tariff – there is no surcharge for a private ride and no commission for passengers.

### Can a private person drive a taxi in Vienna?
No. Carrying passengers for money in Austria requires a taxi licence and a taxi driver's permit. Only registered, official taxi operators drive through taxi wien app.

### Can I order a private taxi to Vienna Airport?
Yes. Enter your address and Vienna Airport as the destination; from the city centre the estimated fare is about €34 per vehicle.

### How do I pay for the private taxi?
Directly to the driver – in cash or by card where the driver accepts it. taxi wien app does not process ride payments.

## Commission-free taxi in Vienna: how does it work?
With taxi wien app you request a licensed taxi in Vienna without paying the platform a commission, booking fee or service charge. You see the route and the estimated fare at the official tariff before you send the request, and you pay the fare directly to your driver.

- No passenger commission: taxi wien app takes no commission, booking fee or service charge from passengers.
- Estimated fare up front: You see the route and the estimated fare at the official Vienna tariff before you send the request.
- Licensed taxis only: Requests go only to registered, licensed taxi operators – not to unlicensed private drivers.

### What passengers pay
You pay for the ride itself – nothing else. taxi wien app adds no app commission, booking fee or service charge to your request.
taxi wien app does not collect, hold or process ride payments. You pay the fare directly to the driver, in cash or by card where the driver accepts it.
From Vienna Airport to the city centre, for example, the estimated fare is about €34 per vehicle – the same amount the route page and the app show.

### How the fare is calculated
The estimate follows the official Vienna taxi tariff set by the authorities: a base fee plus a rate per kilometre and for waiting time, applied to the road distance of your route.
Because you see the estimate before you order, there is nothing to negotiate at the kerb. Traffic and waiting time can change the final metered fare.

### Who drives
Since 1 January 2021, carrying passengers by car for money in Austria is a single trade: the taxi. Only registered, official taxi operators with a taxi licence, and drivers with a taxi driver's permit, receive requests through taxi wien app.
Drivers are independent. They are not employees or service providers of taxi wien app, and each one decides which requests to accept.

### What drivers pay
Drivers pay no monthly fee. A platform fee – a software service fee – applies only when a driver voluntarily accepts a request through the app; the current rate is always shown in the Driver App and the Partner Portal.
The fee is billed to the driver and is never taken out of the passenger's fare. Refund rules for driver fees are set out in the refund policy.

### Requesting a taxi in four steps
It takes less than a minute:
- Open the taxi wien app or write to us on WhatsApp.
- Choose your pickup point and destination – anywhere in Vienna, at the airport or beyond.
- Check the route and the estimated fare at the official tariff.
- Send the request: a licensed driver nearby accepts it, and you pay the driver directly at the end of the ride.

### Does taxi wien app charge passengers a commission?
No. Passengers pay taxi wien app no commission, booking fee or service charge; they pay only the fare, directly to the driver.

### Does taxi wien app process ride payments?
No. taxi wien app does not collect, hold or process ride fares. You pay the driver directly, in cash or by card where the driver accepts it.

### How does taxi wien app earn money?
Drivers pay a platform fee only for requests they choose to accept. There is no monthly fee, and nothing is taken from the passenger's fare.

### Are the drivers employees of taxi wien app?
No. They are independent, licensed taxi operators; taxi wien app provides the software that passes ride requests to them.

### Can I see the price before I order?
Yes. The app shows the route and the estimated fare at the official tariff before you send the request – for example about €34 from Vienna Airport to the city centre.

## Uber Vienna or taxi? Uber and taxi wien app compared
Many people in Vienna look for Uber – and wonder whether a taxi is cheaper. Since 2021 the same rules apply in Vienna to taxis and ride-hailing apps. This comparison between Uber and taxi wien app shows where the differences are.

### Uber Vienna vs taxi wien app – the differences
|  | Uber Vienna | taxi wien app |
|---|---|---|
| Tariff | Official Vienna taxi tariff; app pre-bookings may be up to 20% below or above it | Official Vienna taxi tariff; the estimated fare is shown in advance |
| Fee for passengers | Price set by Uber within the tariff range and charged through the app | No commission, booking or service fee for passengers |
| Payment | In the Uber app, processed by Uber | Directly to the driver – cash, or card where accepted |
| Fee for drivers | Service fee per ride; 15% (excl. VAT) for Uber Taxi according to Uber, reports mention up to about 25% depending on the product | Platform fee only for requests the driver chooses to accept; current rate shown in the Driver App |
| Who drives | Licensed taxi operators (mandatory for everyone since 2021) | Registered, official taxi operators with a licence |
| Cancellation | Cancellation fee possible after 5 minutes (equal to the base fare, according to Uber) | No cancellation fee from the platform; arrangements are made directly with the driver |
| How to order | Uber app | taxi wien app, website or WhatsApp |

### Same rules for Uber and taxis since 2021
With the amendment of Austria's passenger transport law, the taxi and private-hire trades were merged on 1 January 2021. Since then the official Vienna taxi tariff applies to every provider – Uber and Bolt included.
For rides booked in advance by phone or app, the price may be up to 20% below or above the tariff. Uber uses this range for its prices: at quiet times a ride can be cheaper, at peak times more expensive.

### How Uber earns money in Vienna
Uber charges the ride through its app and keeps a service fee from the fare. For Uber Taxi, Uber announced a service fee of 15% (excl. VAT); media reports mention commissions of up to a quarter of the fare depending on the product and the driver's status.
If you cancel an Uber Taxi ride after more than 5 minutes, a cancellation fee equal to the base fare can apply.

### How taxi wien app works
With taxi wien app you publish a ride request; licensed taxi operators nearby see it and decide themselves whether to accept. Before you send it, you see the estimated fare at the official tariff.
Passengers pay taxi wien app no commission, booking fee or service charge. You pay the fare directly to the driver – the platform does not process payments. Drivers pay a platform fee only when they choose to accept a request.

### Which is cheaper in Vienna: Uber or a taxi?
Because both are bound to the same tariff, prices are close. With Uber the price can differ from the tariff by up to 20% depending on demand – both down and up. With taxi wien app the official tariff applies and you pay no surcharge to the platform.

### Is there Uber in Vienna?
Yes. Uber operates in Vienna but has had to follow the official taxi tariff since 2021; pre-booked app rides may be up to 20% below or above it.

### Is Uber cheaper than a taxi in Vienna?
Not as a rule. Both follow the same tariff. Uber can be slightly cheaper at quiet times, but also more expensive when demand is high.

### How much commission does Uber take in Vienna?
Uber keeps a service fee from the fare – 15% (excl. VAT) for Uber Taxi according to Uber, and up to about 25% depending on the product according to media reports.

### Do I pay a fee with taxi wien app?
No. Passengers pay taxi wien app no commission, booking fee or service charge; the fare goes directly to the driver.

### Can I take taxi wien app to Vienna Airport?
Yes. A ride from the city centre to Vienna Airport costs about €34 per vehicle (estimate at the official tariff).

## Drive with taxi wien app
Get ride requests from Vienna Airport and across Vienna straight to your phone with the taxi wien Driver app.

- No monthly fee: You only pay a platform fee when you choose to accept a request – the current rate is always shown in the Driver App.
- Paid Directly: Passengers pay you directly at the end of the ride – no waiting for payouts.
- Flexible Hours: Go online whenever you want. You decide when and where you drive.
- Driver Support: Our team helps you with your account, documents and the app.

A valid Austrian taxi licence and the documents requested in the app are required. Contact: support@taxiwien.app. Pages: https://taxiwien.app/en/become-a-driver · https://taxiwien.app/de/fahrer-werden · https://taxiwien.app/tr/surucu-ol

## We're here to help
Get help with your ride, your booking, your account or your driver application. E-mail support@taxiwien.app or write on WhatsApp (https://wa.me/491639542799). We usually reply within a few hours.

### How do I book a ride?
Book instantly in the taxi wien app, use the booking form on our homepage or send us your request on WhatsApp.

### How are prices calculated?
Fares follow the official taxi tariff set by the City of Vienna. The app shows an estimate before you ride, and you pay the driver directly at the end of the trip.

### Can I cancel my ride?
Yes, you can cancel a request in the app or let us know on WhatsApp before your driver is on the way.

## taxi wien app Terms of Use
Passengers do not pay a platform commission, booking fee, or usage fee. Registered drivers independently decide whether to accept each request; an applicable platform fee is recorded only after a driver accepts. taxi wien app does not assign drivers, process ride fares, or act as the transport operator.

### 1. Acceptance, scope, and eligibility
These Terms apply to all passengers, drivers, and other users of taxi wien app and the related taxi wien app website. The service is intended only for persons who are at least 18 years old.
Registration and continued use require full acceptance of these Terms and the Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, you must not create an account or use the platform.

### 2. Nature of the platform
taxi wien app is a digital request publication and communication platform. It helps passengers publish ride requests and allows nearby drivers to review and accept those requests at their own discretion.
Berlin GmbH LLC does not provide transportation itself, is not a taxi operator, does not guarantee driver availability, and does not become a party to the direct transport arrangement formed between passenger and driver after a request is accepted.

### 3. Account registration and accurate information
Passengers and drivers must register with a valid mobile phone number and complete one-time code verification. Passengers must also provide full name, and drivers must provide the onboarding information required by the platform.
All users are responsible for keeping their account details accurate, current, and truthful. False, incomplete, outdated, or misleading information may lead to suspension, rejection, or permanent closure of the account.

### 4. Passenger request workflow
To publish a ride request, a passenger must allow the app to access location services, select or confirm a pickup point, and choose a destination by map selection or address search. The app may display an approximate fare before the request is sent.
Submitting a request does not guarantee that any driver will accept it. A request may be ignored, declined, missed, or later canceled through the direct communication between passenger and driver.

### 5. Driver acceptance and no passenger-to-driver assignment
taxi wien app sends requests to nearby registered drivers, but it does not assign a passenger to a specific driver. Each driver independently decides whether to accept or reject a request.
For each request, the Driver App may show the passenger’s name, verified mobile phone number, pickup location, destination, and approximate fare information prepared from official local tariff references. These details are made available so the driver can make an independent decision; they are not a driver assignment, a guaranteed trip, or a fare collection instruction from Berlin GmbH LLC.

### 6. Direct communication outside the app
Once a request is accepted, the passenger and driver must confirm the ride details directly with each other. Their names, phone numbers, and relevant ride details may then be shared for that purpose.
taxi wien app does not assign a driver, guarantee that a ride will take place, or become a party to the subsequent arrangement. Communication may happen through any direct method chosen by the passenger and driver themselves.

### 7. Estimated prices, route results, and accuracy notices
Any fare shown in the app before a request is sent is an approximate, informational estimate prepared using local tariff logic, route information, and expected travel time. It is not a fixed, guaranteed, or binding fare issued by Berlin GmbH LLC.
Map search results, selected addresses, route times, and fare estimates depend in part on third-party services and real-world conditions. taxi wien app does not guarantee that these values will always be complete, accurate, or available.

### 8. Passenger payments and no passenger platform fee
Passengers do not pay taxi wien app any platform commission, booking fee, or usage charge for sending a request through the service.
taxi wien app does not collect, process, hold, or mediate the passenger ride fare. The ride fare is paid directly by the passenger to the driver inside or in connection with the vehicle, using whatever payment methods the driver makes available.

### 9. Driver platform fee, account balance, and debt limit
taxi wien app sells registered drivers access to request information that lets them independently decide whether to accept a potential ride. The applicable platform fee is recorded only when that driver voluntarily accepts a request.
Platform infrastructure and operating costs may change over time. For that reason, the applicable platform-fee percentage and account debt limit are dynamic values and are not published as fixed values on the website. The current values applicable to each registered driver are displayed in that driver’s Driver App.
The Driver App shows the registered driver’s current platform-fee percentage, accepted-request fee history, outstanding account balance, and current debt-limit status. taxi wien app does not collect, hold, process, or mediate the passenger’s ride fare; the platform fee is separate from the fare paid directly by the passenger to the driver.
If an unpaid driver account balance reaches the current limit shown in the Driver App, the driver cannot accept new requests until the outstanding balance is paid. Once the balance is resolved, request acceptance is restored in accordance with the account status shown in the Driver App.

### 10. No refunds of driver platform fees
Passengers do not pay money, platform fees, or ride fares to taxi wien app. The passenger pays the ride fare directly to the driver, outside taxi wien app’s payment flow.
Driver platform fees are final and non-refundable. A driver is shown the request information in the Driver App and independently decides whether to accept or reject it; taxi wien app does not assign the request to that driver. Once the driver chooses to accept, the applicable platform fee is recorded on that driver’s account for the access and request information already provided.
No refund, reversal, or credit of a driver platform fee is due if the driver later cancels, the passenger later cancels, the trip does not proceed, or the parties change plans after acceptance. The complete policy is available on the Refund Policy page.

### 11. Driver documents, compliance, and independent status
Drivers must be official taxi service providers and must provide the documents requested during onboarding, including vehicle and regulatory records such as driver license, tax-related documents, and other official information required by the platform.
Drivers are solely responsible for the truth, validity, and current status of the documents and information they upload. Berlin GmbH LLC may review documents for onboarding purposes, but it does not guarantee 100% authenticity or legal sufficiency of every uploaded record.
Drivers are not employees, agents, or service providers of Berlin GmbH LLC in the labor-law sense, and taxi wien app does not create a direct or indirect employment relationship, partnership, or transport employment structure with drivers.

### 12. Prohibited conduct
Users and drivers must not misuse the platform, interfere with the service, or submit unlawful, fraudulent, abusive, or misleading information.
- Creating fake accounts or using another person phone number or identity
- Uploading false driver documents, invalid vehicle information, or misleading profile details
- Using the platform in a way that harms other users, drivers, the platform, or third-party providers
- Attempting to access restricted systems, interfere with verification flows, or evade payment obligations owed by a driver to the platform

### 13. Suspension and termination
Berlin GmbH LLC may reject, restrict, suspend, or terminate any account where it reasonably believes there is fraud, misuse, document inconsistency, unpaid driver debt, unlawful conduct, platform abuse, or another material violation of these Terms.
The platform may also disable features, pause request visibility, or remove access when required by operational, legal, technical, or safety concerns.

### 14. No warranty and service availability disclaimer
taxi wien app, the website, and all related services are provided on an as-available and as-functioning basis. Berlin GmbH LLC does not guarantee uninterrupted operation, route accuracy, address accuracy, driver availability, estimated fare precision, successful communication, or any specific transport outcome.
No statement on the platform should be interpreted as a warranty that a request will be accepted, that a ride will occur, or that any particular map, fare, timing, or communication result is guaranteed.

## taxi wien app Privacy Policy
This Privacy Policy explains how Berlin GmbH LLC and taxi wien app collect, use, disclose, store, and protect personal data when passengers, drivers, and website visitors use the taxi wien app platform, mobile applications, and support channels. By creating an account or using the service, you acknowledge this Policy together with the Terms of Use.

### 1. Controller, scope, and platform context
Berlin GmbH LLC, registration number 1467717.06, with its registered address at 212 N. 2nd St. STE 100, Richmond, KY 40475, USA, operates taxi wien app and the related website under the taxi wien app brand. This Privacy Policy applies to passengers, drivers, support requests, and website visitors who interact with the platform.
The service is a taxi request publication and connection platform. It is not a transportation operator, does not dispatch drivers as an employer, and does not process passenger ride fares.

### 2. Eligibility and acceptance
The platform is intended only for individuals who are at least 18 years old. By registering, verifying a phone number, or continuing to use the service, you confirm that you are at least 18 and that the information you provide is accurate.
Users and drivers must review and accept the applicable Terms of Use and this Privacy Policy before registration is completed.

### 3. Passenger data we collect
Passenger accounts require enough information to create and publish a ride request, communicate with a driver after acceptance, and keep the service operational.
- Full name and mobile phone number
- One-time verification code status and related account verification records
- Current GPS location when the app is used for pickup positioning
- Pickup point, destination, map pin selections, and searched addresses
- Optional profile photo, if the passenger chooses to upload one
- Ride request history, approximate route and fare information, and support records

### 4. Driver data we collect
Driver accounts require a broader set of data because the platform is intended for official taxi service providers who may receive ride requests from nearby passengers.
- Full name, mobile phone number, and optional profile photo
- Current working location needed to surface nearby ride requests
- Vehicle details such as plate number, make, and model
- Driver's license, tax-related records, and other official documents requested during onboarding
- Applicable platform-fee information, accepted-request fee history, outstanding account balance, debt-limit status, and support communications

### 5. Phone verification, maps, and third-party providers
Passengers and drivers register with mobile phone numbers. To complete login and verification, taxi wien app sends one-time codes through third-party communication service providers. Phone numbers must therefore be shared with those providers to perform the verification process.
The platform also uses third-party map, geolocation, and address-search providers, including services comparable to Google or Mapbox. Search results and suggested addresses are provided through those services and may not always be complete, current, or 100% accurate.

### 6. How request data is shared between passengers and drivers
When a passenger publishes a ride request, the system may send it to nearby registered drivers. The Driver App may show the passenger's name, verified mobile phone number, pickup point, destination, and approximate fare information so each driver can independently decide whether to accept or reject the request.
taxi wien app does not assign a passenger to a specific driver. If a driver accepts, the passenger can receive the driver's relevant identifying and vehicle information so the parties can arrange the ride directly.
After acceptance, communication and any ride arrangement take place directly between passenger and driver. taxi wien app does not control whether the parties communicate by phone call, messaging app, SMS, or another direct method chosen by them.

### 7. Why we use personal data
We use personal data to create and maintain accounts, verify identities through phone-based authentication, publish ride requests to relevant nearby drivers, and support direct communication after a request is accepted.
We also use data to calculate and display approximate fare information, record driver-side platform fees after a driver independently accepts a request, display account balances and debt-limit status in the Driver App, monitor misuse, review driver onboarding materials, respond to support requests, enforce platform rules, and maintain basic service integrity.

### 8. Estimated price, map accuracy, and service notices
Displayed fare information is an estimate prepared using route information, travel duration, and tariff logic derived from official local pricing references. It is shown for advance information only and is not a binding fare guarantee, payment undertaking, or transport quote issued by Berlin GmbH LLC.
Because route data, traffic conditions, map results, and third-party address services can vary, taxi wien app does not guarantee that a displayed destination, travel time, or estimated price will be fully accurate in every case.

### 9. Sharing with service providers and legal disclosures
Personal data may be shared with third-party providers only to the extent reasonably necessary to operate the platform, including verification, hosting, infrastructure, analytics, support, and map or geolocation services.
Data may also be disclosed when required by applicable law, a valid legal process, or a binding order from a competent authority.

### 10. Retention, deletion, and account closure
We retain personal data for as long as reasonably necessary to operate the service, protect security, review disputes, enforce financial records relating to driver platform usage, and comply with legal obligations.
Users may request deletion or account closure by contacting the official support address. Some records may still be retained where retention is reasonably necessary for fraud prevention, dispute handling, accounting, compliance, or legal defense.

### 11. Security measures and document verification limits
taxi wien app uses reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect personal data, but no digital system can guarantee absolute security, uninterrupted availability, or zero risk.
Driver documents may be reviewed for onboarding and platform integrity, but Berlin GmbH LLC cannot guarantee 100% authenticity or completeness of every document submitted by a driver. Drivers are responsible for ensuring that all uploaded records are true, valid, and current.

### 12. Policy changes and contact
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect platform, operational, legal, or technical changes. The latest version published on the website or in the app will control from its effective date.
Questions about this Privacy Policy, deletion requests, or account-related privacy concerns should be sent to the official support address below.

### 13. Advertising, sponsored content, and recommendations
taxi wien app may display third-party advertisements, sponsored placements, commercial recommendations, affiliate content, promotional banners, or other commercial messages within the website, app, email, support flow, or push-notification surfaces. Berlin GmbH LLC does not guarantee the accuracy, legality, availability, safety, quality, pricing, or truthfulness of any such advertising or third-party claim and does not assume responsibility for losses, disputes, or reliance arising from those materials.
Any relationship, purchase, booking, click-through, communication, or reliance involving an advertiser, sponsor, affiliate partner, or promoted third party is solely between the user and that third party unless Berlin GmbH LLC expressly states otherwise in writing. Responsibility for advertising content remains with the advertiser to the maximum extent applicable, and the user's use of or reliance on such content remains at the user's own risk and discretion.

### 14. Push notifications, sounds, badges, and background permissions
taxi wien app may request permission to send push notifications, badges, sounds, alerts, reminders, marketing messages, service notices, account warnings, operational notices, promotional messages, security alerts, and other visual or audible device communications. If the user enables those permissions, Berlin GmbH LLC may use them from time to time for operational or commercial purposes permitted by law and platform rules.

Berlin GmbH LLC may, at any time and without separate prior notice except where mandatory law requires otherwise, assign, sell, lease, license, outsource, restructure, merge, split, delegate, transfer, or otherwise reorganize all or part of taxi wien app, the website, the related developer accounts, operating rights, intellectual property, commercial relationships, data-processing operations, or business assets to an affiliate, purchaser, successor, investor, operator, contractor, or other third party.

## Driver Platform Service, Fees and Refund Policy
This policy applies to registered driver accounts using taxi wien app. It defines the digital platform service supplied by Berlin GmbH LLC, when a driver platform fee is recorded, how an outstanding account balance affects request acceptance, and the refund position for that service.

### 1. Service supplied to registered drivers
taxi wien app supplies registered drivers with digital access to ride-request information through the Driver App. The service enables a driver to review an available request and make an independent commercial decision whether to accept or reject it.
For a request made available to a driver, the Driver App may display the passenger’s full name, verified mobile phone number, pickup location, destination, and an approximate fare calculated from official local tariff references. This information is supplied for the driver’s own decision-making.

### 2. Independent acceptance; no assignment or transport service
taxi wien app does not assign a passenger to a driver, does not require a driver to accept a request, and does not guarantee that an accepted request will result in a completed journey.
Each registered driver independently accepts or rejects each request. Berlin GmbH LLC does not provide the transport service, is not a party to the transport arrangement, and does not employ or direct the driver in relation to that arrangement.

### 3. Passenger fare is outside the platform payment flow
The passenger pays the ride fare directly to the driver. taxi wien app does not collect, hold, process, settle, or mediate passenger ride fares.
The driver platform fee described in this policy is a separate charge for digital access to request information. It is not a charge to the passenger and is not a deduction from or processing of the passenger’s ride fare.

### 4. Driver platform fee and account record
When a registered driver voluntarily accepts a request, the applicable platform fee is recorded on that driver’s account. The fee is calculated using the current percentage displayed for the driver account in the Driver App and the approximate fare information shown for the accepted request.
Platform infrastructure and operating costs may change over time. Accordingly, the platform-fee percentage and account debt limit are dynamic values and are not published as fixed values on the website. Before and after acceptance, the Driver App makes the current platform-fee percentage, accepted-request fee history, outstanding balance, and current debt-limit status available to the driver. The driver is responsible for reviewing this information and maintaining an accurate account balance.

### 5. Outstanding balance and acceptance restriction
If the outstanding balance on a driver account reaches the current debt limit displayed in the Driver App, the account cannot accept new ride requests until the outstanding balance is paid.
This restriction concerns access to new requests only. It does not alter the direct relationship between a passenger and a driver in respect of a request that the driver has already accepted.

### 6. No refund, reversal, or credit of driver platform fees
Driver platform fees are final and non-refundable once a driver voluntarily accepts a request. The fee is charged for the digital service already supplied: access to the relevant request information and the opportunity for the driver to make an independent acceptance decision.
No refund, reversal, or account credit of a driver platform fee is available if the driver later cancels, the passenger later cancels, the journey does not proceed, the fare is not collected by the driver, or either party changes plans after acceptance.
This policy applies except where a non-waivable requirement of applicable law provides otherwise.

### 7. Company information and contact
Berlin GmbH LLC, registration number 1467717.06, operates taxi wien app. Registered address: 212 N. 2nd St. STE 100, Richmond, KY 40475, USA. Corporate website: https://berlingmbh.com/.
Questions concerning driver platform fees, account balances, or this policy must be sent to support@taxiwien.app.
